'''Kalee Narvis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Kalee was the daughter of [[Jarl Narvis]] and [[Gille Narvis]], the owners of the company [[Legal Arms Ltd.]] During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kalee traveled with the company's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Aggressive Negotiation]]'' to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], where it was going to deliver weapons to the [[Cularin Militia]]. However, before it could do so, it was boarded by members of the [[Thaereian military]], who murdered most of the crew, including Kalee's father. Kalee and Gille were the only crewmembers left alive, as the Thaereians were called away before they could finish them off. The ''Negotiation'' was left dead in space, but the [[Heroes of Cularin]] soon arrived and rescued Kalee and Gille.
